final: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(feature_count) AS overall_count, COUNT(*) AS site_count FROM site_totals), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, CAST(feature_count AS REAL) / overall_count AS share, 1.0 / site_count AS average_share FROM site_totals CROSS JOIN totals) SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
